How to use your letterhead

Word: open the downloaded RTF in Microsoft Word, edit, and save as a Word document. The logo is embedded; the header and footer repeat on additional pages.

Copy: paste using Keep Source Formatting. Use Download for Word for official printed letters, as copying may not preserve page size or repeating headers and footers.

HTML: the logo is embedded in the file. Open in a browser to read or print; choose A4 and turn off the browser's own headers and footers. The preview is a continuous layout; Word handles page breaks for longer letters.
